pf2e-customizations.settings.lockPicking: Enable the interactive pin-tumbler lock picking puzzle, triggered by the GM via the Request Lock Pick macro.
Number of mistakes a player can make while picking a lock before it counts as a critical failure (broken pick).
Don't show the how-to-play screen before each lock picking attempt. You can still open it from the (?) button on the puzzle. This only affects your own client.
Draws the pin's correct window and strain zone directly on the dial. For testing/tuning only — leave off for real play. This only affects your own client.
pf2e-customizations.macro.requestLockPic: Only the GM can request a lock pick attempt.
The Lock Picking Minigame setting is disabled. Enable it in Module Settings and reload the world first.
pf2e-customizations.lockPicking.instruct: Drag each pin to rotate it. It'll resist and shudder as you push it without finding the notch; ease off before it fights back too long and it'll hold its ground safely. Find the spot where it turns freely, then click Set Pin. Pushing too hard for too long snaps it back to start and costs you a mistake — too many mistakes and the pick breaks. Give Up at any time to walk away with a safe failure instead of risking that.
pf2e-customizations.lockPicking.card.req: {actor} is attempting to pick a {tier} lock.
pf2e-customizations.lockPicking.card.alr: Someone else is already attempting this lock.
pf2e-customizations.lockPicking.card.cri: Lock picked cleanly, without a single mistake!
pf2e-customizations.lockPicking.card.fai: No luck this time. Feel free to try again.
pf2e-customizations.lockPicking.card.cri: The pick snaps! This lock resists further attempts until new tools are used.

Don't show the how-to-play screen before each timeline puzzle attempt. You can still open it from the (?) button on the puzzle. This only affects your own client.
pf2e-customizations.macro.requestTimelin: Only the GM can request a timeline puzzle attempt.
The Timeline Puzzle Minigame setting is disabled. Enable it in Module Settings and reload the world first.
Enter a valid target DC and circumstance modifier.
pf2e-customizations.timelinePuzzle.instr: Once you start, you'll see clues about the true order of a set of events. Drag the event blocks (or use the arrow buttons) to put them in chronological order, using the clues as your guide. Click Check Order any time to test your current arrangement — a wrong guess costs nothing, so try freely. The clock starts the moment you click Begin, so make sure you're ready first; the faster you solve it, the better the outcome.
pf2e-customizations.timelinePuzzle.ready: Ready when you are — clues and the timer both start the moment you click Start.
